name: Key / Luggage or anything else tag

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a customizable key tag or luggage tag featuring a flat, rectangular body with rounded corners and a raised outer border. One end of the tag tapers into a rounded triangular extension with a circular hole, designed for attaching a keyring or strap. The main body of the tag has a recessed central area intended for custom text, which sits slightly lower than the protective outer edge.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable key tag or luggage tag in OpenSCAD with an adjustable length, width, and corner radius. It should feature a recessed central area for text, a raised border, and a tapered end containing a hole for a keyring, with parameters to control the tag thickness, indent depth, border width, and hole radius.
captions.factory: The script defines the base tag shape using a 'tag' module, which utilizes 'hull()' to combine five cylinders positioned at the four corners of a rectangle and one extended corner for the keyring attachment. A 'RRect' module creates a rounded rectangle representing the recessed area. The final tag is constructed by subtracting the keyring hole (a cylinder) and the recessed area ('RRect') from the main 'tag' shape using a 'difference' operation, after which text is rendered inside the pocket using the 'write' library.
